title: Ancient Chinese diagram of twin serpent creators as a double helix

tellings.quote: I found a diagram from ancient China going back 600 years in China

plain: The writer Peter Levenda says he found a diagram from China, which he puts at about 600 years old, showing twin serpent creators coiled around each other in a shape he likens to the double helix of DNA. He tells Michels this from his own research and credits a work called Stairway to Heaven, without saying more about it. If he is right, an old creation image would echo the shape of life's genetic code.
